core.rule: stages 0-4 by difficulty and taught set; no signature of its own

classical.rule: composer era from composers.json, or a classical form or dance; unknown composer stays UNKNOWN

chords-pop.rule: played from chord symbols: symbols present, or a written part that reduces to a chord-symbol accompaniment

blues-boogie.rule: twelve-bar form, with shuffle or boogie left hand

jazz.rule: swing mark or swung figures, seventh-chord harmony, ii-V motion; sevenths alone are not jazz

ragtime.rule: duple oom-pah or stride left hand under a syncopated right hand; multi-strain form for full rags

theory-ear.rule: drills and short texts; items are generated drills chosen by their parameters

improv-compose.rule: the learner makes the music; items are lead sheets, grooves and forms to improvise over

hymns-gospel.rule: four-part chorale texture or a hymn tune with symbols; 'is a hymn' is metadata

holiday.rule: an occasion: carol titles and tags only

latin.rule: a named Latin cell or accompaniment: habanera, tresillo, clave, tumbao, montuno, bossa, tango

rock-metal.rule: power chords, octave or pedal bass, riffs; the track's job is reducing a band song, which is metadata

jam.rule: guitar keys and a lead-sheet form; playing with a guitarist is the activity

technique.rule: a technical figure is the content: scale, arpeggio, double notes, octaves, trill, repeated notes

practice.rule: lessons on method; any item at the learner's level

0.calibration: no published grade separates stages 0-2; needs a method-book order or a beginner syllabus as reference (research)

2.calibration: as stage 0; initial is ABRSM's grade below Grade 1

3.calibration: difficulty.level fitted on an outside graded set (CIPI, PSyllabus: research)

9.calibration: as stage 3; few graded sets reach diploma (research)

A1.1.not_in_notes: reading them aloud or obeying them is played
